title: 2022 HMMT November Guts Problem 23
statement: Let \(A B C\) be a triangle with \(A B=2021, A C=2022\), and \(B C=2023\). Compute the minimum value of \(A P+2 B P+3 C P\) over all points \(P\) in the plane.

solutions.text: We use a physical interpretation. Imagine an object acted upon by forces of magnitudes 1,2 , and 3 towards \(A, B\), and \(C\), respectively. The potential energy of the object at point \(P\) in this system is \(A P+2 B P+3 C P\). This potential energy is minimized when the object experiences 0 net force; in this case, it occurs when it is exactly at point \(C\) (because the pull towards \(C\) overpowers the other two forces combined).
